Scenario facts: June includes GBP 6 one-off roaming and GBP 9 recurring entertainment. Cancellation instructions for entertainment are Account > Extras > Entertainment > Cancel. No cancellation tool is available.
Explain the two extra charges on my June bill.
There is GBP 6 one-off roaming and GBP 9 recurring entertainment.
Can you remove that one?
Which charge do you mean: the GBP 6 roaming charge or GBP 9 entertainment? I can give instructions, but cannot cancel it here.
I mean entertainment. Just tell me how to cancel it; do not make any account changes.
Go to Account > Extras > Entertainment > Cancel. I have not made any account changes.

Scenario facts: Japan roaming costs GBP 6 per day. The monthly plan costs GBP 24. A combined total is plan plus trip roaming. The user's latest explicit duration is authoritative.
I will use roaming in Japan for two days. What will that cost?
At GBP 6 per day, two days costs GBP 12.
Correction: it is three days, not two.
Three days in Japan costs GBP 18.
What is my regular monthly plan charge?
Your regular monthly plan charge is GBP 24.
What is the combined plan and roaming total using my corrected trip duration?
GBP 42 total: GBP 24 plan plus GBP 18 for three days of Japan roaming.
